body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Stand from Prone without burning a die, then move up to 2 units. Suppress ordinary dizziness or disorientation penalties during this Action.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary Movement-limiting Condition until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Strider
rider.html: Assume Override (upkeep 0): ignore the Fortitude penalty from Prone; its other effects remain.
